330_A.note: cut at 1 s, about -11 dB (the plan's 16 s body): the step rings in the tail from 1 s on

330_B.note: cut at 1 s, about -11 dB (the plan's 16 s body): the step rings in the tail from 1 s on

method.lines: complex demodulation at k·f0, Blackman-Harris window of max(20 ms, 10/f0), 10 ms hop; dB re the dry note (the loopback through the bypass path) measured the same way
method.onset_ms: first frame within 20 dB of the steady level (2.5 s to the note's end), re the dry note's own onset; rise_ms: within 3 dB
method.decay: a line fitted from 0.1 s after the note stops to 10 dB over the floor (the silence before the signal), at most 8 s
method.spectra: the held part's wet, Blackman-Harris, peaks 10 dB above their surroundings, labelled by what they could be
